'''0.28c''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that fixed various ranked match issues and added several [[Premium]] [[equipment]] sets.

==Changelog==
* Fixed random changing of game mode from ranked matches to non-ranked ones
* Fixed error when new level notification did not pop up
* Added displaying protection from [[anomalies]] in the lobby
* Added dynamic Leagues range detection in ranked matches
* Added information about bonuses depending on match level to the post-match statstics screen
* Changed the system of awards distribution in ranked matches with regard to equipment bonus and ranked match bonus
* Quick commands are now highlighted in chat
* Fixed bug causing crash when a player quickly dragged decals and camos in the item modification window
* Item search attempts increased to 5
* Added bonus items to in-game [[shop]]

===Renaissance Army===
* [[AK-12]] damage reduced to 45
* Added Guards set
* Added Sokol-M set
* Added Molot UM2-A set

===Fringe Settlers===
* Added Follower set
* Added Berserker set
* Added Leshy set

===Scavengers===
* Added Guerilla set

===Black market===
* Added "Marauder MKII" set
* Added "Omikron MKII" set
